regions.merged_text: Cyril Van Walleghem - 48 - drinks terribly and always quarreling & cursing except when sober which is very seldom. Has wife and three - oldest 15. Has not been to sacraments since in America 16 yrs. ago. Not known if he ever made his confession or communion. Wife started perpetual enrollment of him last month at $1.00 per week ... To-day ( 1.00) and promises to read the "City of God" - Life of Mary Immaculate if husband goes to sacraments at least X mas.
